name: Antigravity Global Universal Rules
description: Enterprise universal rules enforced across all platforms (Zero-Demo, No Raw Float Currency, Mandatory Tenant ID, Soft Delete, BDT/Asia/Dhaka defaults).

rules.name: Zero Placeholder Code
rules.description: Prevent production functions with empty bodies or TODO placeholder comments.
rules.recommendation: Implement complete business logic with error handling before release.

rules.name: Monetary Float Prevention
rules.description: Never calculate financial balances or invoices using native double/float.
rules.recommendation: Use Decimal, BigDecimal, or integer minor units (paisa/cents).

rules.name: Multi-Tenant Isolation
rules.description: Every database query on shared tables must filter by tenant_id / organization_id.
rules.recommendation: Append 'AND tenant_id = :tenantId' to prevent cross-tenant data leaks.

rules.name: Platform Safe Imports
rules.description: Do not import dart:io or win32 APIs directly in shared web/mobile libraries.
rules.recommendation: Use conditional imports or universal_io to support Web and Desktop targets.

rules.name: Hardcoded Secret Prevention
rules.description: Detect exposed API keys, private tokens, or hardcoded passwords.
rules.recommendation: Store sensitive keys securely in environment variables or SecretStorage.
